agents.drug_class_hint: generic placeholder for patients' existing standard-of-care anticancer regimens (mostly antibodies, hormonal agents, bone-targeting agents); no specific drug is the study question

coder_notes: Health-services study of in-home delivery of existing standard-of-care regimens across many tumour types; glioblastoma is in the conditions and the eligible-disease list. The registered drug intervention is a generic placeholder, not a named agent; the eligible-regimen list names drugs but none is a trial question, so they are not listed individually. Bevacizumab appears in that list.
